validate_environment_quantizer: validate the environment for 8-bit bitsandbytes quantization with accelerate and device map checks
update_device_map_quantizer: update the device map for 8-bit quantized model to auto-select cuda, npu, hpu, xpu or cpu device
param_needs_quantization_check: check if a model parameter needs 8-bit quantization based on bitsandbytes Linear8bitLt modules
dequantize_model_weights: dequantize a model previously loaded with 8-bit quantization and replace with original precision weights
get_weight_conversions_prequantized: get weight conversion operations for deserializing pre-quantized 8-bit bitsandbytes model weights
